NATO jet investigates Lithuania 'drone' that was flock of birds

A NATO fighter jet was scrambled in Lithuania on Tuesday after an alert reported a potential drone threat. The object was later identified as a flock of birds. The incident occurred over Lithuania, a NATO member state bordering Russia's Kaliningrad exclave.
